violations.text: Carnitas, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Per PIC, food items were prepared the previous evening and were observed held at 70 degrees Fahrenheit during the time of inspection and was observed in a deep hotel pan. Food item was voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods were reviewed during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 1-door reach-in freezer. Refrigerator and freezer door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2026
The ceiling in the kitchen and preparation area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 04/23/2024
